goal: Allow external signer wallets to hold private keys and mutate their external signer flag

Verified by testing CLI and Qt with mock signers and Ledger hardware (adyshimony, naiyoma, PraneethGunas)
Supports because it unblocks multisig setups and reduces redundant signer calls (PraneethGunas, fametrano)
